This shifts the focus to the guest stars themselves (Brian Doyle-Murray, Jonathan Katz, and Jeremy Shada) and their real-world relationships, not the fictional family relationships of the character Finn. This misunderstanding leads to a deviation from the original task, causing the subsequent steps to pursue irrelevant information and ultimately result in an incorrect conclusion.
